mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies at Verona City Hall with a temperature of 67 degrees. The waxing crescent moon is out, and the overnight low will dip to 63 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The Verona Senior Center is inviting residents to volunteer. You can help out with various programs, provided you can commit to serving at least two times per month. Some roles involve light physical activity, and they offer both online and paper application forms at the front desk.

We have a packed schedule starting tomorrow with the Dane County Farmer's Market and live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking further ahead, the Cave Carnival is this Saturday, and the Epic Systems UGM kicks off this Sunday.
The Verona Police Department reported a notable incident on Friday, August 8, where a drone pilot assisted in the arrest of a burglary suspect who had fled into a corn field.
Enjoy the Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough flavor today. The store is currently closed, but they will reopen tomorrow at 10 AM, when the flavor of the day will be Turtle.
